world.title: Indian couple in US advises young Indians not to move abroad, explains why: 'I don’t feel like I’m accepted here'
world.summary: An Indian couple residing in the US has cautioned young Indians against moving abroad, suggesting they reconsider their choices. They argue that many opportunities previously sought overseas are now accessible in India. The couple shared their personal experiences, expressing feelings of not being accepted in the US, and emphasized the potential for success within India itself.

world.title: ‘Tit for tat’: Why is Trump cosying up to North Korea’s Kim Jong Un again?
world.summary: US President Donald Trump has renewed his praise for North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, signaling a potential rapprochement. This comes as Trump criticizes South Korea for not supporting US efforts against Iran. Analysts suggest this strategy may be aimed at sending political signals to both Pyongyang and Seoul, reigniting a contentious diplomatic issue from Trump's first term.

world.title: Pak TikToker with 1.3M followers shot dead; 5th killing of woman influencer in a year
world.summary: Pakistani TikToker Shamso Bibi, aged 28 and with 1.3 million followers, was shot dead in Taxila on August 14, coinciding with the country's Independence Day. She was traveling with her siblings at the time. Her family suspects a financial dispute may have led to her murder, highlighting a troubling trend of violence against women influencers in Pakistan.

business.title: RBI MPC minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra says inflation largely supply-driven, sees FY27 average at 5%
business.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that current elevated inflation is mainly due to supply shocks and anticipates it will ease after the third quarter. He projected an average inflation rate of 5% for FY27. Additionally, Poonam Gupta noted that while easing seems unlikely, the possibility of a rate hike may arise depending on future economic conditions.

business.title: Hyundai India Announces Car Price Hike From Sep 2026
business.summary: Hyundai Motor India will implement a price increase across its passenger vehicle lineup starting September 2026. The hike will be up to 1%, with the specific amount varying by model and variant. This decision reflects the company's strategy to adjust pricing in response to market conditions and costs. Further details on affected models will be provided closer to the date.

business.title: Mahindra XEV 9S Gets New Six-Seater Variants
business.summary: Mahindra has introduced three new six-seater variants of the XEV 9S, featuring captain seats in the second row. These options are available on Pack Two Above, Pack Three, and Pack Three Above variants. There are no changes to the vehicle's features or powertrain. The addition aims to enhance seating flexibility for customers seeking more comfort.

technology.title: Apple camera AirPods could debut soon with Visual Intelligence
technology.summary: Apple's upcoming AirPods may feature camera technology and Visual Intelligence, according to a Bloomberg report. A demo video found in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate suggests these enhanced earbuds could debut alongside the iPhone 18. The new functionality aims to enable the AirPods to better understand user interactions and surroundings, marking a significant advancement in wearable technology.

technology.title: All Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Beta Rewards and How to Get Them
technology.summary: The Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Beta allows players to experience the game before its official release on October 23, 2026. Players can earn various rewards by reaching specific unlock levels during the beta. The beta includes multiplayer maps, modes, a Campaign mission, and additional Warzone content, providing a comprehensive preview of the game's features.

technology.title: Realme P4s set to launch soon with 8,000 mAh battery, 6,500 nits, and IP69
technology.summary: Realme is set to launch the P4s smartphone soon, featuring an 8,000 mAh battery and a Samsung M14 AMOLED display with a resolution of 2,772 x 1,272 pixels and a 144 Hz refresh rate. The device supports USB-C charging at 80 watts and boasts a peak brightness of 6,500 nits, along with an IP69 rating for water and dust resistance.

sports.title: Here's how Google Photos' new Redact tool will work
sports.summary: Google Photos has introduced a new Redact tool in version 7.89, allowing users to obscure sensitive information. It features three redaction modes: Mosaic, Mosaic Light, and Blur. The tool is accessible in the Markup section alongside Pen, Highlighter, and Text. Initial tests confirm its functionality, following an earlier APK teardown that revealed its existence in the app's code.

sports.title: Exclusive: Man Utd Hold Talks With Jorge Salinas
sports.summary: Manchester United has engaged in discussions with Jorge Salinas' representatives regarding a potential transfer. The left-back from Racing Santander is being considered as part of the club's strategy to strengthen their defense. The data team at Old Trafford reportedly views Salinas as a promising talent, indicating interest in multiple options for the left-back position ahead of upcoming seasons.

health.title: Tech Neck Starts Young: How Screen Time Is Affecting Kids' Musculoskeletal Health
health.summary: Orthopedic specialists at Houston Methodist report an increase in neck pain, poor posture, headaches, and upper back discomfort among children and teens, attributed to excessive screen time, commonly known as "tech neck." As students return to school, they are expected to spend significant hours on laptops, tablets, and smartphones, both in and out of the classroom.

health.title: At 30,000 feet: What pilots and cabin crew should know about cancer risk
health.summary: A JAMA study indicates that pilots and cabin crew face higher mortality rates from specific radiation-related cancers due to exposure to cosmic radiation. Experts clarify that while there is an association, it does not confirm that cosmic radiation is the sole cause. Other factors, such as disrupted sleep and circadian rhythms, may also contribute to these health risks.

health.title: What happens in the brain when you’re scrolling?
health.summary: A study published in 'NeuroImage' examined the brains of 56 young adults using fMRI while they watched short videos. Findings suggest that viewing short-form content on platforms like TikTok and Instagram may decrease activity in brain regions associated with cognitive control and self-regulation. The study also indicated a connection between this effect and glutamate levels in the brain.

science.title: Cluster of neurons performing same function across tasks may lend the brain its flexibility: Study
science.summary: A study has identified clusters of neurons in the brain that perform the same computation across different tasks. This discovery provides the first evidence for the existence of brain modules, suggesting a mechanism for the brain's flexibility in handling various functions. The findings may enhance understanding of how the brain efficiently adapts to diverse cognitive demands.

science.title: Cluster of neurons performing same function across tasks may lend the brain its flexibility: Study
science.summary: A study has identified clusters of neurons in the brain that perform the same computations across different tasks. This discovery offers the first evidence of modularity in brain function, suggesting that these neuron groups contribute to the brain's ability to adapt and manage multiple functions efficiently. The findings enhance understanding of cognitive flexibility in neural processing.

science.title: Ultrastable laser pulses bring control of individual electrons closer
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Oldenburg have developed a laser system that generates 200,000 nearly identical infrared pulses per second with exceptional phase stability. This advancement enhances the ability to control individual electron motion, potentially paving the way for new applications in quantum technology and precision measurements. The system's stability is crucial for future advancements in electron manipulation.

entertainment.title: Akkineni Heroes Absolutely Slay This Magazine Cover
entertainment.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni, son of legendary actor Akkineni Nageswara Rao, features on a magazine cover with his sons, Naga Chaitanya and Akhil Akkineni. The three generations of the Akkineni family have had a remarkable year, each achieving significant success with career-defining hits. This collaboration highlights their legacy in the film industry and their continued impact on Indian cinema.

entertainment.title: Jailer 2 Box Office: Needs Less Than 350 Crore Globally To Overrule Highest-Grossing Franchise Of Tamil Cinema
entertainment.summary: Jailer 2 aims to surpass Rajinikanth's highest-grossing Tamil film franchise, 2.0, by grossing less than 350 crore globally. The competition highlights the ongoing rivalries in Indian cinema, particularly among Rajinikanth's films. As box office records are challenged, Jailer 2's performance will be closely monitored to see if it can achieve this significant milestone in Tamil cinema history.

entertainment.title: Inside Bhagyashree’s palatial Mumbai home: From dramatic black entrance, private temple, all white kitchen naturally formed Ganesha on tree that made her buy it
entertainment.summary: Bhagyashree, a Bollywood actress, resides in a luxurious Mumbai home reflecting her royal upbringing. The residence features a dramatic black entrance, a private temple, and an all-white kitchen. A naturally formed Ganesha on a tree influenced her decision to purchase the property. Despite her long career in film, the grandeur of her heritage remains evident in her living space.
